verdict.rationale: Godot's full engine source is public on GitHub under the permissive MIT license. The official license page explicitly allows distributing modified versions, even commercially or under proprietary terms, and the repo points to compilation instructions for every supported platform. Community posts corroborate that developers read the engine code (critiquing its pathfinding implementation) and contribute engine PRs. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the build-from-source workflow itself (the pack only points to the compilation docs), and a hands-on report of building and running a custom-modified engine.
